name: Layout Slideshow
description: Full-height image slideshow where each slide arranges its photos in a different layout (split, stack, deck, scatter, grid, orbit, shear) with staggered transitions, a big title and arrow navigation.
contents: Slides, each with a layout name, image list, title, text and optional caption
Large serif title with body text per slide
Slide counter, previous and next arrow buttons, loading ring
behavior: Images are preloaded and a loader ring shows until they decode
Navigating animates the current images out and the next slide's images in with per-layout motion and staggering
Arrow keys navigate, optional autoplay and looping
Layout sizes use clamp and vw units so slides scale on small screens
editableByProps: Slides, their layouts, images, titles, text and captions
Colors, fonts, title size, stage size and padding
Looping, autoplay, keyboard, arrows, counter, loader and transition speed

needsCodeEdit.change: Change motion or timing of a layout transition

fixed: Arrow keys are captured on window while keyboard is true and removed on unmount
Layout names are limited to split, stack, deck, scatter, grid, orbit, shear; unknown names use the shear arrangement and split motion
